# metagrab

> metagrab is a Go library, CLI and HTTP API that turns a URL into a link preview: title, description, image, favicon, canonical URL, Open Graph, Twitter Cards, JSON-LD and oEmbed. URLs come back absolute. Apache-2.0, current release v0.1.0, requires Go 1.26 or newer.

Install with `go get github.com/josephgoksu/metagrab@latest`. Main call: `metagrab.Fetch(ctx, url, metagrab.PreviewFields)` returns a `*metagrab.Link`; errors are `*metagrab.FetchError` with a machine-readable `Code`. `metagrab.Parse(r, url, mask)` works on HTML you already have.

Field masks: `MetadataFields` and `PreviewFields` stop reading at `</head>`; `RichFields` adds JSON-LD from the whole page. For user-supplied URLs use `metagrab.NewClient(metagrab.WithDenyPrivateNetworks())`, which blocks private and reserved addresses at dial time, including after redirects.

Benchmarks (median fetch from a local server, 1.8 MB page): metagrab 1.84 ms, goscraper 7.09 ms, go-opengraph 8.35 ms, otiai10/opengraph 16.88 ms.
